snippet.title: Savebot: The Last Garden – Gameplay Trailer | Teach robots to bring a planet back to life
snippet.description:
80 seconds of the real game. Your planet is a desert; your goal is to bring it back to life with robots who only know what you teach them. In the Workshop you write their programs with blocks: simple gestures first, then conditions on some thirty sensors, routines, variables and signals to get a whole team working. The Gaia gauge says how alive the planet is; at 100 %, the shuttle leaves for the next world: Thalassa and its tides, Twilight between fire and ice, Sylve overrun by the grey, and the Ark.

Up to 80 robots, 15 trades, a debugger with breakpoints, no enemies.

Savebot: The Last Garden comes out on Steam on November 16, 2026, in English and French. Add it to your wishlist:
